_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), from the research pass of 2026-10-30 (data/stations/research/fi_KUO).

levels.name: Tunnel level: the passenger tunnel from the east end of the station building under the tracks
Platform level: island platform 1/2 and platform 3
levels.name_source: Digitraffic infra-api laiturit (Väylävirasto / Fintraffic, CC BY 4.0) via /home/claude/packs_fi/FI-KUO/_report.json and kuopio_platform_vayla.geojson, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_fi/FI-KUO.json), read 2026-10-30

sources.note: Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, © Maanmittauslaitos, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/fi_KUO).
Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0): platform heights (3D research pass; data/stations/research/vayla_platforms_FI.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM with the research pass's platform numbers, entrances, heights and amenities.

Platform heights from Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0); 2 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/fi_KUO).

3._source: Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0), Digitraffic infra-api laiturit 1.2.246.586.1.37.4870729, read 2026-10-30, CC BY 4.0: tracks 3, class korkea = 0.55 m above rail, 320 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey

1–2._source: Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0), Digitraffic infra-api laiturit 1.2.246.586.1.37.2584943, read 2026-10-30, CC BY 4.0: tracks 1, class korkea = 0.55 m above rail, 324 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey

structures.name: Kuopion rautatieasema (station building)
structures._source: Outline OSM w87807952 (ODbL); roof = median of 6 unclassified laser points >2 m above the terrain model inside the outline; Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, newest per sheet (clack_fi_mml05_P5114D3), Maanmittauslaitos (National Land Survey of Finland), CC BY 4.0; scanned P5114D3 2021-07-05 (20210102_Swissphoto_Kuopio_kesa); from data/stations/research/fi_KUO/kuopio_structures_heights.geojson (metres above the platform surface, 96.38 m RH 2000, laser 2021-07-05)

structures.name: Kuopion matkakeskus (transportation)
structures._source: Outline OSM w810700766 (ODbL); roof = median of 22 unclassified laser points >2 m above the terrain model inside the outline; Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, newest per sheet (clack_fi_mml05_P5114D3), Maanmittauslaitos (National Land Survey of Finland), CC BY 4.0; scanned P5114D3 2021-07-05 (20210102_Swissphoto_Kuopio_kesa); from data/stations/research/fi_KUO/kuopio_structures_heights.geojson (metres above the platform surface, 96.38 m RH 2000, laser 2021-07-05)

terrain._source: ground from the laser's ground points, 1 m (data/stations/research/fi_KUO/kuopio_ground_1m.tif), sampled every 5 m; Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, © Maanmittauslaitos, CC BY 4.0. Heights above the platform surface (96.38 m N2000, laser 2021-07-05)
